zh-Hans: 1.7.24（265）候选：二维 DWG/DXF 图纸可在应用内直接绘制与修改（线、圆、圆弧、多段线、单行文字、尺寸与引线、移动/复制/旋转/缩放/镜像/修剪/延伸/偏移、图层与测量）；每次保存都由应用内同一引擎重新编码并重新解析校验，代表性导出另由 LibreDWG 离线独立读取作发布资格核对（并非每次保存都运行，也不保证任意第三方图纸）。图纸助手可基于当前图纸回答、定位图元、测量并给出需确认的彩色改动预览。Office 提供 Word 样式/列表/对齐/表格、Excel 数字格式/行列/冻结/排序/筛选/跳转/重算、PPT 复制/排序/对齐等命令，文本替换、公式、公式错误定位与同格式图片替换为包级可靠路径；这些引擎命令已实现但仍待真机资格确认——运行中按引擎与格式实际提供，不会因缺少真机回执而禁用；只有引擎确无实现路径的操作才标记不可用，绝不以截图或 PDF 冒充原文件编辑。手记新增逐字搜索定位、按页导出 PDF、.floenote 归档及提案/预览/确认流程。画布图纸节点保持矢量、不栅格化；备份已含媒体子工程与素材（未应用 CAD 草稿/历史纳入备份仍在冻结前补齐，本候选尚不能依赖备份恢复未保存 CAD 草稿）；旧版扁平编辑首次打开时一次性迁移。图片新增矩形/椭圆/套索选区、加减选/反相/羽化、复制/剪切/填充与更多文字/调色；视频新增音乐波形/淡入淡出与精确边缘裁切。请重点测试：iPad 横竖屏与分屏、iPhone 窄屏、CAD 保存重开与中文/无单位图纸、Office 保存重开、手记搜索定位与导出、画布媒体备份恢复，以及原文件保护。AI 改动一律先确认；云端生成需自行配置服务，本轮未做真实付费模型与实机性能验收。
en-US: 1.7.24 (265) candidate: edit 2D DWG/DXF drawings in app (lines, circles, arcs, polylines, single-line text, dimensions and leaders; move/copy/rotate/scale/mirror/trim/extend/offset; layers and measuring). Every save is re-encoded and re-verified by the same in-app engine; representative exports are additionally cross-read offline by LibreDWG for release qualification (not run per save, and not a guarantee for arbitrary third-party drawings). The Drawing Assistant answers about the current drawing, locates entities, measures, and shows a colour-coded proposed change that needs your confirmation. Office adds Word styles/lists/alignment/tables, Excel number formats/rows/columns/freeze/sort/filter/go-to/recalculate, and PPT duplicate/reorder/align commands; text replace, formulas, formula-error locations and same-format image replacement use the reliable package path. These engine commands are implemented but still awaiting on-device qualification: the running app offers them based on actual engine/format support rather than disabling them for lack of a receipt; only operations the engine genuinely cannot perform are marked unavailable, never faked with a screenshot or PDF edit. Notes adds per-word search positioning, selected-page PDF export, .floenote archives and a propose/preview/confirm flow. Canvas drawing nodes stay vector (never rasterized); backups include media child projects and assets (including unapplied CAD draft/history in a backup is still being completed before the freeze, so this candidate cannot yet restore unsaved CAD drafts from a backup); legacy flattened edits migrate once on first open. Images gain rect/ellipse/lasso selections with add/subtract/invert/feather, copy/cut/fill and more text/colour controls; video gains a music waveform/fades and precise edge trimming. Please test iPad portrait/landscape and split view, iPhone compact layout, CAD save/reopen with Chinese/unitless drawings, Office save/reopen, Notes search/export, Canvas media backup/restore and original-file protection. AI changes always require confirmation; cloud generation needs your own configured provider, and real paid-model and physical-device performance are not accepted this round.
